skills.description: Byakuya slashes the enemy in front with Senbonzakura up to 4 times, dealing damage equal to 194%~???% of ATK. Dancing Petals (Bankai Basic Attack): Byakuya wields the blade formed by sakura petals and attacks the enemy up to 5 times, dealing damage equal to 410%~???% of ATK and accumulating Spiritual Pressure on hit. Piercing Blade (In Bankai state, press and hold basic attack when Spiritual Pressure is 50% or higher): Byakuya controls the Sakura Blade to release a continous shockwave on the enemy, consuming Spiritual Pressure over time and dealing damage equal to 594%~???% of ATK. When the attack ends, deals extra damage equal to 360%~???% of ATK. While active, pauses all of Byakuya's status timers. Removes Bankai when the attack ends.
skills.name: Zanjustu

skills.description: Senbonzakura's blade scatters into countless tiny sharp pieces that strike the enemy after 3.5 seconds, dealing damage equal to 287%~???% of ATK. During this time, you can switch on-field characters, and Byakuya will remain on the field until the attack completes. While Byakuya's Battlefield Skill is active, releasing this technique grants 4 Battlefield Skill Energy.
skills.name: Scatter, Senbonzakura

skills.description: Byakuya fully splits the blade into tiny blades and strikes multiple times faster than Shikai, dealing damage equal to 264~???% of ATK. He then enters the Bankai state, enhancing both of his basic attacks and techniques. The Bankai state lasts 15 seconds and remains active even if Byakuya is switched out.
skills.name: Bankai - Senbonsakura Kageyoshi

skills.description: After countering an attack, Byakuya instantly releases Bakudo to restrain an enemy and follows up with Hado Number 33: Sokatsui, dealing damage equal to ???% of ATK.
skills.name: Counter

skills.description: While Byakuya's Battlefield Skill is active, all teammates deal 30% more Slash DMG. Byakuya condenses the petals floating around him into blades and stabs the enemy at the same time, pinning them to the ground for 75% of ATK damage. If Byakuya's Battlefield Skill energy has dropped to zero after releasing this attack, pressing the Battlefield Skill button again lets Byakuya release a follow-up strike equivalent to the fourth hit of his basic attack. The Battlefield Skill button activates within 2 seconds of any teammate releasing a special attack, technique, or counterattack, and cannot be triggered any other way.
skills.name: Funeral of a Thousand Blades

skills.description: Use Flash Step to avoid attacks right before they hit. Perfect Dodges inflict True Time Freeze for 1.5 seconds, during which Byakuya gains 15% ASPD and 25% MSPD for 4 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
skills.name: Flash Step
